name: WeatherStar 4000+
description: Live retro weather for any city, from the WeatherStar 4000+ (International), as programmes you can schedule: a 24/7 weather channel, or short local forecasts between shows. Needs Chrome or Edge on this computer.
author: SchedularrTV

settings.label: WeatherStar address
settings.description: The WeatherStar 4000+ (International) site to show. Leave empty for the public one, or point it at your own copy (npm start or its Docker image, e.g. http://localhost:8080/).

settings.label: Browser
settings.description: Chrome, Edge or Chromium, run hidden to draw the forecast. Leave empty to find one automatically.

settings.label: ffmpeg
settings.description: Leave empty to use the ffmpeg set under App settings.

settings.label: Stream address
settings.description: How ErsatzTV reaches this scheduler. Leave empty unless ErsatzTV runs on another machine or in a container.

settings.label: Capture frames per second
settings.description: How often the forecast is captured (5 to 30). The stream itself is always 30 fps; lower uses less CPU.

settings.label: Keep a station running after it goes off air (seconds)
settings.description: So back-to-back weather segments don't restart the browser each time.
